label: Lists
title: 10 Most Popular AI Short Dramas on YouTube in 2026
excerpt: AIMB editorial list of the 10 AI short dramas on YouTube that have each crossed 60 million views, with the comments that explain why people keep watching.
imageAlt: Three AI-generated short drama stills side by side: a mafia boss and a woman in a rain-soaked city, a couple on a tropical estate, and two bodyguards near a burning wreck in a city skyline.
body: There are so many mafia romance stories. Billionaires who you didn't know were billionaires. Revenge. Here are 10 english AI Short Dramas that have gotten over 60 Million views on youtube. And the comments will tell you why.
Most Ai short dramas are trash. You can tell its AI most of the time. Characters faces morph, talking is weird and there's always the same love story.
But for some reason people love watching them.
These 10 short dramas have all gotten over 60 Million views. 566k likes and 15k comments. Some commenters say they hate that its AI but they can't help but watch.
They may not be the best AI Series of 2026 but they're growing the interest in this industry.

1. The Plus-Size Bride Abandoned by a Mafia Don — Romance, Mafia, Drama. Aurora leaves her mafia boss husband and takes charge of her life. People enjoy that she got stronger without becoming someone else. This comment has 2,700+ likes on it. Someone stated it was ai slop but the plot was better then most tv shows. Its the highest viewed show on our list. I think its because of the female character not because its about the mafia.

2. Married Into a Wealthy Family by Mistake — Romance, Billionaire, Contract Marriage. Shes married to a rich CEO by accident and romance ensues. Most of the comments were about how ai does certain things wrong. One person commented on how the female lead has the same sweater on the entire movie but everyone else changes. Around 1900 people thought this was funny as well. People have also noticed the paintings change size and how they argue over money. Lol we're all addicted to these dumb romances.

3. He Hated All Women, Until He Met the Mother of His Secret Child — Romance, Secret Baby, Family Drama. The CEO finds out he has a relation to a woman and her baby. I think its one of the better made ai dramas. People have praised the script for having smarter characters and less unnecessary fights. Someone even commented it should be made into a real drama. People will recognize a good story if they see one.

4. Plus-Size Catfishes a Mafia Don — Romance, Mafia, Secret Identity. The girl used filtered photos on a dating app and her new boyfriend was the mafia boss. People love how she didn't have to be skinny to find a man. Another comment that got over 3.3k likes was someone saying they didnt believe ai could create full length stories that look this realistic. Its very believable that people will start to fall in love with ai generated people.

5. She Marries a Ruthless Mafia Don — Mafia Romance, Betrayal, Drama. Once she finds out her fiance was cheating she ends up with a Mafia boss. Many love that they changed their outfit which I never see people say about ai dramas. Some people complain that the story was too short and left them with many questions. But the characters are well loved and want more.

6. He Kicked Me Out Like Trash — Revenge, Family Drama, Romance. A girl has her life ruined by her husband and his family. Comments consist of arguing over why the female lead made the choices she did. Most complain about it not being realistic and some love to dissect the drama between each family member. As if they were characters on any other soap opera.

7. I Married a Stranger to Keep My Inheritance — Romance, Contract Marriage, Billionaire. She marries him so she can keep her inheritance. Many people love that they act normal towards one another and don't try and fight. They said its the only ai drama they actually liked. People must like watching characters be smart once in a while.

8. Married a Stranger, He's the Richest Man — Romance, Billionaire, Secret Identity. She marries some guy and he's rich. Lol the comments are just as funny as the show. Everyone says things like how can she spend all her money on that? Why was she pregnant again? Or why did they say that line. Most say its trash but they cant stop watching. I mean we all know what were watching right?

9. She Gave Up the Mafia Throne for Him — Mafia, Revenge, Family Drama. Mafioso daughter gives up everything for love and her family turns on her. Many commenters can relate to why she decided to stand up for herself. Most of the comments revolve around having self respect and giving up everything for another person. Glitching from ai but many comments about why the female did what she did.

10. They Called Him a Rent-a-Cop — Action, Thriller, Secret Identity. Retired special forces body guard hides his past to protect rich girls daughter. One of the only non rom com movies on this list. People like how it's edited and has some cool action shots for the most part. People are also making jokes about the physics and a guy that looks like jason statham for one scene. At least they know what quality they want out of an ai movie.

It's easy to dismiss these dramas. A lot of them follow the same tropes. Bad dialogue, inconsistent characters and plots that dont take you anywhere. You could even say most of them would be considered AI slop if they were made traditionally. However. These shows are getting people to watch. They're building an audience for this type of media. People want better characters. Better dialogue and less obvious errors. As time goes on more will come. There will always be cheap slop that follows the same formula. But AI is getting better and we're starting to see some great results. The AI shorts we see in 2026 will seem low quality down the line. Were going to see some incredible movies and series.
